summary: Verified both reported chat bug fixes on /lobby/chat. All messages render LEFT-aligned regardless of sender (own FREE message from test@cartoonix.ro appears on the left with grey bubble; 0 elements found with flex-row-reverse). Yahoo emoticons render at native 18x18 (naturalWidth=18, boundingClientWidth=18) both in the emoji picker and inside sent messages — no forced upscaling, images are crisp. Regressions all pass: PLUS admin gets golden chat-bubble-plus with PlusIcon crown next to name; FREE user gets grey chat-bubble (#2a2a2a); chat-emoji-btn opens picker, clicking emoji-smile inserts ':smile: ' into chat-input; chat-send posts and the message appears in the list with the :smile: shortcode rendered as inline . Incremental polling working (no duplicate messages observed across multiple sends).
critical_code_review_comments: ChatRoom.jsx: currently no distinction between own and other messages (by design per bug fix). Consider a subtle border/highlight for own message if UX later needs it, but current behavior matches the requested spec.
MessageText.jsx: emoticon lacks explicit width/height attributes. Browser uses natural 18px, but adding width=18 height=18 would prevent CLS on slow loads.
test_credentials: FREE: test@cartoonix.ro/test1234, PLUS admin: admin@cartoonix.ro/Cartoonix2026! (both worked)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Chat UI at /lobby/chat is fully working: left-alignment, native-size emoticons, PLUS golden bubble + crown, FREE grey bubble, emoji picker, send flow, incremental polling.
